main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: ô fortunatas bonis & mansuetis Prin-cipibus regiones: ô beatos cives, quibus Principum suorum benignitate, tran-quillè licet in patriis avitísque sedi-bus, cum coniugibus & liberis conse-nescere. nam plerunque certè vsuue-nit, vt remedia malis ipsis, quibus ea quæruntur, deteriora sint. Anni sunt, vt opinor, sexdecim, Princeps illu-strissime, ex quo Deus optimus maxi-mus partem Germaniæ Rhenanæ nō exiguam fidei ac potestati C.T. com-mendauit. vix dici potest, quantam ex eo tempore tranquillitatem, & tanquam in pacato mari malaciam to-to Palatinatu videre licuerit: quàm pacata semper sedataque omnia, quàm piè, sanctè, & religiosè con-stituta. page.notes: The footer "★ 4" is a star signature and page number at the foot centre. The text runs to the bottom of the printed column; the last word "cor-" is hyphenated and continues on the next page. Some letters are doubtful in the scan (e.g. "consenescere" may contain a Cyrillic-like form; read as "consenescere"). Words such as "vsuuenit" and "malaciam" are as printed.
